items.exampleEn: The schoolteacher read a story to the children.
items.exampleZh: 那位學校老師唸了一個故事給孩子們聽。

items.exampleEn: Children learn basic arithmetic in their first years of school.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在上學的頭幾年學基本算術。

items.exampleEn: My uncle teaches geology at a university.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔在大學教地質學。

items.exampleEn: "Break a leg" is an idiom that means "good luck."
items.exampleZh: 「Break a leg」是一句意思是「祝好運」的慣用語。

items.exampleEn: Every culture has its own proverbs.
items.exampleZh: 每個文化都有自己的諺語。

items.exampleEn: She is a great innovator in the car industry.
items.exampleZh: 她是汽車業的一位偉大創新者。

items.exampleEn: Nobody in our class flunked the test this time.
items.exampleZh: 這次我們班沒有人考試不及格。

items.sentenceEn: Don't worry if you flunk one test.
items.sentenceZh: 如果有一次考試不及格，別擔心。

items.audioEn: Our village school needs a new schoolteacher who can teach music.
items.audioZh: 我們村裡的學校需要一位會教音樂的新老師。
items.questionZh: 村裡的學校需要什麼樣的人？
options: A driver for the school bus.
A teacher who speaks three languages.
A teacher for the music classes.

items.sentenceEn: Learning an idiom a day is a good habit.
items.sentenceZh: 每天學一個慣用語是好習慣。

items.sentenceEn: Geology tells us how mountains were made.
items.sentenceZh: 地質學告訴我們山是怎麼形成的。

items.stemEn: Even a simple ____ problem like seven plus eight can be hard for young kids.
items.stemZh: 即使是七加八這樣簡單的算術題，對小孩子來說也可能很難。

items.stemEn: If you don't study, you might ____ the final exam.
items.stemZh: 如果你不讀書，期末考可能會不及格。

items.passageEn: My grandmother was a schoolteacher for thirty-five years. She taught everything: arithmetic, reading, and even a little geology, because she loved rocks. Every week, she taught her students a proverb or an idiom. She often used the proverb "Slow and steady wins the race." When a student flunked a test, she never got angry; she just said, "Try again." She also found new ways to teach. For example, she made up a song to help children remember the five vowels. People in our town called her an innovator. Her devotion to her students was famous, too.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶當了三十五年的學校老師。她什麼都教：算術、閱讀，甚至一點地質學，因為她很喜歡石頭。她每週都會教學生一句諺語或慣用語。她常用「穩紮穩打才能贏得比賽」這句諺語。學生考試不及格時，她從不生氣，只會說：「再試一次。」她也想出了新的教學方法。例如，她編了一首歌，幫助孩子記住五個母音。鎮上的人都說她是一位創新者。她對學生的奉獻也很有名。

questions.questionZh: 奶奶為什麼也教一點地質學？
options: 因為學校要求每位老師都要教
因為她以前是地質學家

questions.questionZh: 學生考試不及格時，奶奶怎麼做？
options: 不生氣，只叫學生再試一次

referenceEn: He flunked his math class last term.
rubricZh: flunk 表示「不及格、被當」，例如 flunk a test 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 proverb 造一個句子，說說一句你喜歡的諺語。
referenceEn: My favorite proverb is "Practice makes perfect."
I like the proverb "Time is money."
rubricZh: proverb 表示「諺語」，例如 an old proverb 等說法
說的是自己的想法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式；說過去的事用過去式等）
